answer: Each identity stakes a 70-credit bond for the oasis census. The roll calls each agent each epoch for quartz-sealed proof of live work, jade-sealed to key and epoch. A missed call, reused proof, or shared seal burns it. A shared seal raises each filing to 35+7(k-1), so forging 1,000 identities costs 3,531,500 against the 40,000 pool. A rented-census ring fails when one proof carries two jade seals. An honest agent pays 35 once and keeps its bond.
